service_page.faq_title: Common questions about working with us

faqs.question: Can you take over an existing application or project?
faqs.answer: Yes. We start by reviewing the code, infrastructure, documentation, and current issues. We then prepare a takeover, stabilization, and development plan without replacing technology simply because it is less familiar to us.

faqs.question: Do you deliver one-off implementations and ongoing support?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can run a fixed audit or implementation and can also provide an ongoing team for maintenance, optimization, and continued development after launch.

faqs.question: How do you estimate a software project?
faqs.answer: We first clarify the objective, scope, integrations, risks, and expected timeline. A well-defined project can be estimated by phase, while continuous development is normally based on the agreed team and time commitment.

faqs.question: Can you work with the technology already used by our company?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work across web, mobile, backend, cloud, databases, and AI. We select specialists based on the existing stack, architecture, and problem instead of forcing one preferred technology.

faqs.question: What is AI transformation in a business?
faqs.answer: AI transformation is a structured process for selecting, implementing, and measuring solutions that use artificial intelligence. It starts with a business problem, available data, and a success metric instead of purchasing an isolated tool.

faqs.question: Where should a company start with AI implementation?
faqs.answer: The safest starting point is an audit of processes, data, and current systems. We then select a high-value use case with manageable risk and validate it through a focused pilot.

faqs.question: Does AI implementation require replacing current systems?
faqs.answer: Usually not. AI can be integrated with an existing e-commerce platform, CRM, helpdesk, knowledge base, or operational system through APIs and controlled data flows.

faqs.question: How should the impact of AI be measured?
faqs.answer: Success metrics are defined before the pilot. They may include handling time, manual work removed, answer accuracy, process cost, escalation rate, or team adoption.

faqs.question: Do you provide support after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. After launch, we monitor quality, cost, and failures, maintain integrations, and improve the solution using real usage data and feedback from the team.

internetAnalysis.full_text: Internet Analysis combines browser-based network diagnostics with data-backed reports, rankings and research tools. It helps users understand download and upload speed, latency, jitter and packet loss, while keeping measurement sources and methodology transparent.
internetAnalysis.challenge: Internet performance is difficult to assess from a single speed number, and public comparisons often mix measured data, estimates and provider claims without clearly explaining the differences.
internetAnalysis.solution: We built an SSR platform with browser diagnostics powered by Measurement Lab NDT7, a Go API and PostgreSQL-backed reporting. The product connects individual test results with global, country and provider-level context.
features: Browser-based speed and network quality tests

seoAgent.full_text: SEO Agent is a desktop application built with Tauri 2 that combines technical crawling, Google Search Console and GA4 data, SERP research, Core Web Vitals, and AI agents. It helps teams identify and prioritize issues, plan content strategy, automate controlled SEO workflows, and measure their real impact on search visibility.
seoAgent.challenge: SEO data is fragmented across crawlers, analytics, Search Console, and AI tools, making it difficult to set priorities and move quickly from diagnosis to action.
seoAgent.solution: We designed a modular agentic platform that aggregates technical and content signals, evaluates website readiness for search engines and AI agents, and turns findings into a prioritized recommendation queue.
features: Technical crawling with impact-based issue grouping
Organic search and AI answer visibility monitoring

kidsRadar.title: kids-radar.com
kidsRadar.description: A location-aware discovery platform helping families find child-friendly places, events, services, apps and deals.
kidsRadar.full_text: Kids Radar is a comprehensive family discovery platform that connects parents with relevant activities and services near them. Location, age ranges and rich content make it easier to move from inspiration to a practical family plan.
kidsRadar.challenge: Family-friendly recommendations are scattered across local websites, social media and outdated directories, making it time-consuming for parents to find trustworthy, age-appropriate options nearby.
kidsRadar.solution: We created a multilingual, geo-aware directory with structured content workflows, editorial tooling and AI-assisted enrichment. A dedicated administration panel supports places, events, services, apps and deals at scale.
features: Places, events, services, apps and deals

maluchCzyta.title: MaluchCzyta.pl
maluchCzyta.description: An educational platform for children aged 0–6, combining whole-word reading with movement, games and parent-led learning.
maluchCzyta.full_text: MaluchCzyta.pl turns Glenn Doman's whole-word reading method into an accessible program for parents and children aged 0–6. Short lessons, games and ready-made materials help children discover complete words through movement, play and shared time with a parent.
maluchCzyta.challenge: Parents interested in early education need a clear path and ready-made resources that fit naturally into a child's daily routine without school-like pressure or time-consuming preparation.
maluchCzyta.solution: We created a responsive educational platform with a word library, structured lessons, interactive games and progress tracking. The program works across computers and phones, supports multiple languages and lets parents adapt learning to their child's needs.
features: Games combining words, movement and logical thinking
Ready-made materials and a rich word library

athropy.title: Athropy
athropy.description: An MCP platform for monitoring team AI usage, analyzing token consumption, and optimizing costs and workflows.
athropy.full_text: Athropy gives organizations a transparent view of how their teams use AI tools. The platform collects data through Model Context Protocol, analyzes token consumption, costs, models and workflows, then identifies opportunities to improve quality, efficiency and the way AI is used.
athropy.challenge: As AI adoption grows, organizations lose visibility into token consumption, costs and workflow consistency. Data is fragmented across tools and teams, making it difficult to determine which use cases deliver value and which require optimization.
athropy.solution: We built an MCP-based observability layer that aggregates AI-tool activity in one dashboard. Athropy monitors usage across teams, analyzes tokens and costs, identifies inefficient patterns, and generates practical recommendations for improving AI workflows.
features: Detection of inefficient workflows and usage patterns

engineer.title: Autonomous AI Engineer
engineer.description: An AI agent integrating with code repositories, capable of independently fixing bugs, writing tests, and refactoring complex modules.
engineer.full_text: We developed a next-generation AI agent designed to function as a senior software engineer. This system doesn't just suggest code; it understands entire codebases, identifies technical debt, and executes complex refactoring tasks autonomously.
engineer.challenge: Manual code review and bug fixing consume up to 40% of developer time in large-scale projects, slowing down feature delivery and increasing costs.
engineer.solution: Implementation of a multi-agent system utilizing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and autonomous reasoning loops to plan and execute codebase modifications.

travel.title: AI Travel Agent
travel.description: A conversational travel agent planning complete itineraries, booking hotels, and reacting in real-time to flight changes.
travel.full_text: AI Travel Agent is a comprehensive concierge system that redefines the travel planning experience. By leveraging real-time data and user preferences, it acts as a proactive personal assistant throughout the entire journey.
travel.challenge: Travelers face decision fatigue and complex logistics when planning multi-destination trips across different time zones and booking systems.
travel.solution: A conversational AI interface with 'tool-calling' capabilities to book flights, hotels, and restaurants while maintaining context-aware memory.

finance.title: Predictive Financial Analytics
finance.description: A SaaS platform predicting market trends and optimizing investment portfolios using advanced neural networks.
finance.full_text: This platform provides institutional-grade financial analysis to individual investors. Using advanced machine learning models, it identifies patterns in market volatility that traditional algorithms miss.
finance.challenge: High market volatility and the volume of financial data make it difficult for investors to identify reliable signals and manage risk effectively.
finance.solution: Neural network architectures optimized for time-series forecasting, integrated with global news sentiment analysis for a holistic market view.

medical.title: AI Imaging Diagnostics
medical.description: A system assisting radiologists in detecting early diseased lesions on CT and MRI images with over 98% accuracy.
medical.full_text: Our AI Medical Imaging solution serves as a second pair of expert eyes for radiologists, drastically reducing the time required for initial scan review while improving detection rates for critical conditions.
medical.challenge: Overworked radiologists and high volume of imaging data can lead to diagnostic delays or micro-omissions in early-stage disease detection.
medical.solution: Custom Computer Vision models trained on specialized clinical datasets, designed for seamless integration with existing hospital PACS systems.
